title: ElectroNeek Wins 2023 Artificial Intelligence Breakthrough Award | Unlocking New Possibilities with RPA, AI, and GPT
summary: See why ElectroNeek has won the coveted "Best Robotic Process Automation (RPA) Company Award" in this year's AI Breakthrough Awards. Read on to discover how their technology is making RPA, AI, and GPT accessible to all businesses.
body_markdown:
**Austin, TX, June 26, 2023** - **ElectroNeek, the leading intelligent automation platform for Managed Service Providers (MSP) and businesses, has been selected as the winner of the “Best Robotic Process Automation (RPA) Company Award.” This is a prestigious international AI Breakthrough Awards program conducted by AI Breakthrough.**


## **What is AI Breakthrough Awards?**


[AI Breakthrough](https://aibreakthroughawards.com/2023-winners/) , is a part of Tech Breakthrough, a leading market intelligence and recognition platform for global technology innovation and leadership. As a result, the AI Breakthrough Awards program commits itself to recognizing excellence in Artificial Intelligence technologies, services, companies, and products.The AI Breakthrough Awards provide public recognition for the achievements of AI Bot companies and products. The recoginized categories including AI Platforms, Robotics, Business Intelligence, AI Hardware, NLP, Computer Vision and more.


## **Why was ElectroNeek Recognized as an AI Breakthrough Award-Winner?**


https://youtu.be/GW2t2JAYLVM?si=f96jJ6LmwoIq4MB-


ElectroNeek offers MSPs automated and scalable products at no extra cost to clients. The platform paves the way for a unique and cost-effective business model. Furthermore,[ElectroNeek Studio Pro](https://electroneek.com/platform/studio-pro/) features cutting-edge AI-powered capabilities such as:


- **Ask AI** : This feature allows even RPA bots to perform complex tasks like document analysis or communication with a prospect.
- **Edit Text with AI:** Turns on conversational AI features for every ElectroNeek smart RPA bot, free of charge.
- **AI Assistant Code Generator** : Revolutionary[no-code development of RPA bots](https://electroneek.com/platform/easley-ai/) powered by OpenAI.
- **AI Document Processing:** Inside ElectroNeek’s IntelliDocs product, AI modules can process over 900+ document models, remove blur, and fix misalignment of documents when scanning.


*"We feel exhilarated to receive recognition as a leader in robotic process automation. We believe in the democratization of AI, RPA, and GPT. These extremely powerful tools help companies to streamline their operations, reduce costs, and increase efficiency.* B *asically* , t *his recognition from AI Breakthrough further validates our mission of helping businesses succeed through intelligent automation."*


**Sergey Yudovskiy, Co-Founder and CEO of ElectroNeek**


The AI Breakthrough Awards program recognizes leading companies, technologies and products across a range of categories within the artificial intelligence industry. Additionally, this year's awards program received more than 3,200 nominations. The creation of this program was to recognize excellence and innovation in organizations that use AI technology and machine learning to address real-world problems.


*“Organizations are deploying Intelligent Robotic Process Automation more frequently than ever before as they search for ways to automate manual processes quickly and cost-effectively. We take pride in receiving the award for Best Robotic Process Automation Company* . *"*


**Dmitry Karpov, Co-Founder and Chief Product Officer**


## **Unlock Your Business's Full Potential: ElectroNeek's Intelligent RPA Transforms Your Operations**


ElectroNeek's cloud-native automation platform offers end-to-end coverage of all business processes regardless of complexity or source systems used. Moreover, it provides seamless integration with popular third-party applications. Applications such as Pax8, ConnectWise, Kaseya, Windows, Remote Desktop, Google Suite, MS Excel, MS Word, MS Exchange, Active Directory, SharePoint, NetSuite, SAP, Salesforce, Power BI, MySQL, QuickBooks, Sage, Zendesk, Hubspot, and many others. The platform also offers easy deployment options into any type of IT environment – without expensive hardware investments or complex integration projects.


With ElectroNeek's intuitive design interface and drag & drop feature set users can easily configure automated tasks. These tasks mimic human behavior while interacting with various software applications via a web browser or desktop application user interface (UI). As a result, ElectroNeek users can use downloadable smart bots that can do simple tasks. These tasks can range from data entry or more complex ones such as digital document processing with AI (Artificial Intelligence).


ElectroNeek is committed to helping businesses achieve success through intelligent automation solutions that are secure, reliable, and cost-effective. With this recognition from AI Breakthrough, we continue our mission of helping businesses maximize productivity through automated workflows.
